notes: Contains several loose mesh shells, likely rings and bracket details, but reads cleanly at table distance.

blind.description: A wooden hitching post or low barrier consisting of two vertical round wooden posts connected near their tops by a horizontal wooden log/rail. Two dark metal rings or brackets loop around the horizontal rail and hang down. The surfaces are smooth, stylized, and continuous with painted wood grain and grey metallic textures. The two vertical posts sit directly and flatly on the ground with no extra base or floating elements.
blind.from_above: A straight horizontal wooden bar capped at each end by a round post top, with two small metal collar bands around the bar, casting an elongated shadow upwards.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/3 the height of the figure (around 2 ft tall) and roughly 4 to 5 ft wide.
